title: Lovely, but they do not hold up.
text: Lovely, but they do not hold up.. Love these, they look just like fairy lights are supposed to. However I got 2 sets; the 1st one got very dim after 2 days, so I replaced the cell batteries, & that strand brightened right back up. But then the 2nd set got dim the next day, so again I changed the batteries (which were full charge; I have a tester). 2nd set just went completely dead. The tiny battery cases are extremely delicate, not really sturdy enough to mess around opening & changing the batteries inside. So if you decide to get them, you should just consider them disposable lights.
